purpose: Run the same fixed family-relative candidate rule over the complete registered metadata clocks of the fixed first two RCM policy videos, without optimization or result selection.
mechanism_contract: For each current candidate family (EXISTING and KNOWN), standardize adapted similarity by that family's own mean and population standard deviation; compare the two family peak z-scores. Select the existing peak on a deterministic tie in favor of existing; otherwise emit NEW. No hand-selected similarity threshold or score sweep is allowed.
selection_rule: Use the first two frozen policy-order videos and every metadata clock frame available for each; no score, label, coverage, or result selection.
interpretation: This is a bounded full-clock lifecycle/support audit for the fixed mechanism. It is not trained memory, independent calibration, predicted-track qualification, an OCD/MOT metric, or Goal A/B/C acceptance.
